out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Containers of handsoap were stored with and above clean equipment and utensils over the three compartment sink. This is a repeat violation from last inspection.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The EHS had the PIC move the containers during the inspection. Discontinue storing chemicals over the three compartment sink.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed an unapproved splitter connected to the mop sink faucet with two hoses connected.
violations.corrective_action: Either remove the splitter or replace it with an approved type such as a Hydro Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve. The EHS showed the PIC a picture of the correct device to install. Correct within 3 days by removing the splitter or replacing it.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Storage of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. Two bottles of handsoap were stored on the same shelving as clean stainless steel containers over the three compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored below food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items to prevent contamination. The CFM moved the containers of handsoap during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: the door handles for the walk-in refrigerator, freeze, and the prep top unit had visible food debris accumulated on them.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. The CFM had all the areas cleaned during the inspection.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: OBSERVATION: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:Sliced tomatoes stacked up on the cold tray at the Sprinkle station were observed to be between 55-57F. Cheese at the 2 DR Prep refrigerator opposite the display station was at 46F.
violations.corrective_action: CORRECTION: The sliced tomatoes were discarded, the cheese was moved to the Walk in Refrigerator. Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Quaternary Ammonium Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the quaternary ammonium compound-based sanitizing solution was observed to be at a concentration less than what is required for effective sanitization of food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils. Observed the sanitizing solution in the 3-vat sink with a concentration of zero ppm total quaternary ammonium compound.
violations.corrective_action: The quaternary ammonium sanitizer used in this facility shall have a minimum concentration of at least 200 ppm OR a concentration between 150-400ppm based on the manufacturer's use directions and using the appropriate test kit. CORRECTED DURING THE INSPECTION.
